mapper.select: SELECT id, stage_id, title, type, content_type, external_url, platform, author, duration_minutes, description, sort_order, is_vip_only, status, view_count, created_at FROM learning_units WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT lu.id, lu.stage_id, lu.title, lu.type, lu.content_type, lu.external_url, lu.platform, lu.author, lu.duration_minutes, lu.description, lu.sort_order, lu.is_vip_only, lu.status, lu.view_count, lu.created_at FROM learning_units lu JOIN path_stages ps ON lu.stage_id = ps.id WHERE ps.path_id = #{pathId} ORDER BY ps.sort_order ASC, lu.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_units (stage_id, title, type, content_type, external_url, platform, author, duration_minutes, description, sort_order, is_vip_only, status, view_count) VALUES (#{stageId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{contentType}, #{externalUrl}, #{platform}, #{author}, #{durationMinutes}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{isVipOnly}, #{status}, #{viewCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_units SET stage_id = #{stageId}, title = #{title}, type = #{type}, content_type = #{contentType}, external_url = #{externalUrl}, platform = #{platform}, author = #{author}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, is_vip_only = #{isVipOnly}, status = #{status}, view_count = #{viewCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, stage_id, title, type, content_type, external_url, platform, author, duration_minutes, description, sort_order, is_vip_only, status, view_count, created_at FROM learning_units WHERE type = #{type} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
